evidence.note: S508 tests only whether Standard DXF export/reimport avoids S507's observed six-of-100 ASTM round-trip record loss, using the same pinned Polo M source and otherwise controlled settings. No V03 gate or criterion changes.

text: S508 is a C:-confined, user-authorized practical CLO test of Standard DXF export mode against the exact S507 ASTM record-loss finding. Keep the Polo M source hash, Standard 1000% import, units, orientation, grain, notch, optimization, and comparison threshold fixed; change only export/reimport mode. This tests record retention and geometry only, not rights, local-only handling, an industrial profile, grades, negative-control behavior, or all-seven acceptance.
